description: This file defines Express.js route handlers for notifications endpoints, including fetching latest notifications and setting opt-in preferences.

methods.name: router.get('/')
methods.description: Handles GET requests to retrieve latest notifications, executing a SQL query to fetch recent notifications from the database.

methods.name: router.post('/opt')
methods.description: Handles POST requests to set user opt-in preferences, currently a no-operation stub that echoes the opt-in status.
